# TechCrunch

> Reporting on startups, venture capital, and the business of technology.

TechCrunch is a technology news publication covering startups, funding, product launches, policy, cybersecurity, AI, and major technology companies. It also publishes newsletters, podcasts, event information, and startup-focused resources tied to the broader tech ecosystem.

## Core News

- [Homepage](https://techcrunch.com/): Main entry point for TechCrunch startup and technology news coverage.
- [Latest](https://techcrunch.com/latest/): Reverse-chronological feed of the newest TechCrunch stories and updates.
- [Startups](https://techcrunch.com/category/startups/): News and analysis on startups, founders, launches, and company building.
- [Venture](https://techcrunch.com/category/venture/): Coverage of venture capital, fundraising, investors, and deal activity.
- [Apps](https://techcrunch.com/category/apps/): Reporting on consumer and business software applications and platforms.
- [Security](https://techcrunch.com/category/security/): Cybersecurity news, breaches, privacy issues, and security research.
- [AI](https://techcrunch.com/category/artificial-intelligence/): Coverage of artificial intelligence companies, products, and policy developments.
- [Transportation](https://techcrunch.com/category/transportation/): News on EVs, autonomous vehicles, mobility, and transportation startups.

## Topic Channels

- [Enterprise](https://techcrunch.com/category/enterprise/): Reporting on enterprise software, cloud infrastructure, and B2B technology.
- [Fintech](https://techcrunch.com/category/fintech/): News and analysis on payments, banking, crypto-adjacent finance, and fintech startups.
- [Media & Entertainment](https://techcrunch.com/category/media-entertainment/): Coverage of streaming, creator platforms, media companies, and entertainment tech.
- [Gadgets](https://techcrunch.com/category/gadgets/): Hardware news, device launches, reviews, and consumer electronics coverage.
- [Government & Policy](https://techcrunch.com/category/government-policy/): Reporting on regulation, antitrust, legislation, and public policy affecting tech.
- [Space](https://techcrunch.com/category/space/): News on commercial space companies, launches, satellites, and space infrastructure.
- [Climate](https://techcrunch.com/category/climate/): Coverage of climate tech startups, energy innovation, and sustainability.
- [Crypto](https://techcrunch.com/category/cryptocurrency/): Reporting on cryptocurrency companies, markets, regulation, and web3 activity.

## Newsletters

- [Newsletters](https://techcrunch.com/newsletters/): Directory of TechCrunch editorial newsletters and subscription options.
- [Daily Crunch](https://techcrunch.com/newsletters/daily-crunch/): Daily digest summarizing major startup and technology stories.
- [TechCrunch Mobility](https://techcrunch.com/newsletters/techcrunch-mobility/): Newsletter focused on transportation, EVs, autonomy, and mobility business.
- [TechCrunch Fintech](https://techcrunch.com/newsletters/techcrunch-fintech/): Newsletter covering fintech startups, funding, products, and regulation.
- [TechCrunch AI](https://techcrunch.com/newsletters/techcrunch-ai/): Newsletter focused on AI companies, models, products, and policy.
- [Startups Weekly](https://techcrunch.com/newsletters/startups-weekly/): Weekly roundup of startup news, fundraising, and founder insights.

## Podcasts & Media

- [Podcasts](https://techcrunch.com/podcasts/): Hub for TechCrunch audio programming and podcast episodes.
- [Equity](https://techcrunch.com/podcasts/equity/): Podcast covering startup finance, venture capital, and market trends.
- [Found](https://techcrunch.com/podcasts/found/): Interviews with founders about company building and startup journeys.
- [Chain Reaction](https://techcrunch.com/podcasts/chain-reaction/): Podcast focused on crypto, blockchain, and web3 developments.
- [TechCrunch Minute](https://techcrunch.com/video/techcrunch-minute/): Short-form video updates on major technology news stories.

## Events

- [Events](https://techcrunch.com/events/): Overview of TechCrunch conferences, summits, and live programming.
- [TechCrunch Disrupt](https://techcrunch.com/events/disrupt/): Flagship startup conference featuring founders, investors, and product launches.
- [StrictlyVC](https://techcrunch.com/events/strictlyvc/): Event series focused on venture capital and startup investing.
- [Sessions](https://techcrunch.com/events/sessions/): Thematic events centered on specific technology sectors and communities.
- [Startup Battlefield](https://techcrunch.com/startup-battlefield/): Startup pitch competition associated with TechCrunch events and coverage.
- [Event Calendar](https://techcrunch.com/events/calendar/): Schedule of upcoming TechCrunch events and related programming.

## Startup Resources

- [Startups](https://techcrunch.com/category/startups/): Broad startup reporting including launches, pivots, and founder stories.
- [Fundraising](https://techcrunch.com/tag/fundraising/): Tagged coverage of startup fundraising rounds and capital strategy.
- [Layoffs](https://techcrunch.com/tag/layoffs/): Tagged reporting on workforce reductions across technology companies.
- [IPO](https://techcrunch.com/tag/ipo/): Coverage of public offerings and startup exits.
- [YC](https://techcrunch.com/tag/y-combinator/): Stories about Y Combinator companies, batches, and ecosystem activity.
- [Pitch Deck](https://techcrunch.com/tag/pitch-deck/): Articles featuring startup pitch decks and fundraising materials.

## Popular Companies & Beats

- [Apple](https://techcrunch.com/tag/apple/): Tagged coverage of Apple products, strategy, regulation, and company news.
- [Google](https://techcrunch.com/tag/google/): Reporting on Google, Alphabet, products, AI, and antitrust developments.
- [Meta](https://techcrunch.com/tag/meta/): Coverage of Meta platforms, AI efforts, hardware, and policy issues.
- [Microsoft](https://techcrunch.com/tag/microsoft/): News on Microsoft products, cloud, AI, acquisitions, and enterprise strategy.
- [Amazon](https://techcrunch.com/tag/amazon/): Reporting on Amazon retail, devices, cloud, and corporate developments.
- [OpenAI](https://techcrunch.com/tag/openai/): Tagged coverage of OpenAI models, products, partnerships, and governance.
- [Tesla](https://techcrunch.com/tag/tesla/): News on Tesla vehicles, autonomy, manufacturing, and executive decisions.
- [Uber](https://techcrunch.com/tag/uber/): Coverage of Uber strategy, mobility, labor, and platform updates.

## About & Editorial

- [About](https://techcrunch.com/about/): Background on TechCrunch, its mission, and publication overview.
- [Contact Us](https://techcrunch.com/contact-us/): Contact information for editorial, tips, and general inquiries.
- [Advertise](https://techcrunch.com/advertise/): Information for brands interested in advertising with TechCrunch.
- [Tips](https://techcrunch.com/tips/): Secure channels and guidance for submitting news tips to reporters.
- [Editorial Calendar](https://techcrunch.com/editorial-calendar/): Planned coverage themes and sponsorship-relevant editorial schedule.
- [Sitemap](https://techcrunch.com/sitemap/): Structured index of TechCrunch site content and sections.

## Policies & Account

- [Terms of Service](https://techcrunch.com/terms-of-service/): Legal terms governing use of the TechCrunch website.

- [Cookie Policy](https://techcrunch.com/cookie-policy/): Information about cookies and tracking technologies used on the site.
- [Accessibility](https://techcrunch.com/accessibility/): Accessibility commitment and support information for site users.
- [Subscribe](https://techcrunch.com/subscribe/): Subscription options for premium access, newsletters, or event-related offers.
